description_sq:
Ne zonen e Kinostudios ne rrugen Aleksander Moisiu ofrohet apartament 2+1 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje ndertimi te ri qe pritet te perfundoj brenda vitit 2026.
Sip. totale e apartamentit eshte 87.9 m2 dhe organizohet ne: korridor, dy dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, nje tualet, nje depo dhe dy ballkone.
Kompleksi rezidencial eshte nder me te miret qe po ndertohet ne zone me akses te menjehershem, prane unazes dhe me shume fasilitete qe e bejne nje jetese sa me komode.
Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontakton
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale in the Kinostudio area on Aleksander Moisiu street. The apartment is located on the third floor of a new building that is expected to be completed within 2026. Sip. the total area of ​​the apartment is 87.9 m2 and it is organized in: corridor, two bedrooms, living room with kitchen area, a toilet, a storage room and two balconies. The residential complex is one of the best that is being built in an area with immediate access, near the ring road and many facilities that make life as comfortable as possible. For more information or assistance in the property, please contact us
